releases.notes:
First release on the Minecraft 26.2 rewrite (Fabric Loom, Java 25). Embeds a Javalin web server for browser-based chat with in-game players.

## Highlights
- Real-time bidirectional chat between web and Minecraft
- Account linking (in-game one-time code → persistent web token, verified badge, anti-impersonation)
- Moderation: `/webchat ban|unban|kick|list|reload|link|unlink`, IP bans, per-IP rate limiting + connection cap, optional profanity filter, optional Origin allowlist, optional built-in TLS
- UI: light/dark theme, @mentions, notification sounds, configurable branding, optional shared password gate, player head/avatar icons
- Connection heartbeat to detect silently-dropped clients faster
- Thread-safety and moderation hardening (rate limiter, ban persistence, broadcast error isolation, atomic username registration)

See the [README](https://github.com/VenB304/fabric-simple-webchat#readme) for installation and configuration details.

## Installing
Drop `web-chat-mod-1.0.0.jar` into your Fabric server's `mods/` folder and start the server.

releases.notes:
# v0.17.2 - Configurable UI & Mentions

This release introduces significant UI/UX improvements to the web client, making it more customizable and user-friendly.

## ✨ New Features

### 🎨 Configurable UI
-   **Server Config**: Admins can now customize the browser tab title and the header bar text via `web-chat-mod.yaml` (`webChatTitle`, `webChatHeader`).
-   **Dynamic Updates**: The web client reflects these changes immediately upon connection.

### 🔔 Notification Controls
-   **Mentions Only**: Added a new checkbox in the settings sidebar to silence notifications *unless* you are mentioned.
-   **Smart Alerts**: "Ding" sound plays only for relevant messages when enabled.

### @ Mention System
-   **Autocomplete**: Type `@` in the chat to see a dropdown of online web users.
-   **Filtering**: List filters as you type for quick selection.
-   **Click-to-Mention**: Click any username in the chat log, sidebar, or system messages to instantly mention them.

## 🛠 Fixes & Improvements
-   **Cursor UX**: Usernames now properly show a pointer cursor to indicate they are clickable.
-   **System Messages**: Join/Leave messages now support click-to-mention.

## Implementation Details
-   Separated "Mentions Only" from sound selection for better usability.
-   Refactored frontend logic for cleaner event handling.

# v0.16.0 - Web Client Overhaul

This release brings significant improvements to the web client architecture and new user-facing features.

## ✨ New Features
- **Web Client Refactor**: The web interface has been split into modular HTML, CSS, and JS files for better performance and maintainability.
- **Timestamps**: Chat messages now display local timestamps.
- **Mentions**: Messages mentioning your username are now highlighted.
- **Config Commands**: Added `/swc reload` and `/swc reset` commands for easier management.

## 🛠️ Technical Improvements
- Migrated configuration to YAML format.
- Consolidated JSON handling to use Jackson (removed Gson).
- Improved thread safety and JSON serialization in WebSocket handling.
- Enhanced API limit and ban management.

## 📦 Installation
Drop the jar into your `mods` folder. Config will auto-migrate/generate on first launch.
